definitions.explanation: A friend from the distant past, someone one has known for a long time. Carries a literary, somewhat nostalgic tone and implies a deep, lasting bond.

examples.japanese: {旧友|きゅうゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I reunited with an old friend.

examples.japanese: {大学時代|だいがくじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旧友|きゅうゆう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I suddenly got a message from an old college friend.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{旧友|きゅうゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{酌|く}み→酌む：02464_kumu⟧⟦{交|か}わし→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧、⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: I shared drinks with an old friend for the first time in ten years, and we had a wonderful time reminiscing.

notes:
USAGE:
More literary and refined than ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ (old friend). Often used in written contexts or when speaking with some formality. Implies a friendship that has endured over many years.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧友|きゅうゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to reunite with an old friend)
- {旧友|きゅうゆう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧ (to visit an old friend)
- {旧友|きゅうゆう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絆|きずな}→絆：02509_kizuna⟧ (bond with an old friend)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幼|おさな}なじみ: childhood friend — specifically someone known since childhood
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧: old friend — casual, everyday expression
- ⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧: best friend — emphasizes closeness, not duration
